name: Tandoor-Recipes
description: Recipes, meal plans and shopping lists for you and your household

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Everything Tandoor keeps: the PostgreSQL database (postgres), your recipe images and files (mediafiles) and this install's own keys (secrets.env). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Tandoor Recipes web UI and API, published on host as 6770

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: ENABLE_SIGNUP
variables.description: Set to 1 so anyone who can open Tandoor can make an account. Leave it 0 and invite people from your space settings instead.
